output_filename.description: File name (not path) where the merged JSON must be written inside the simulators/ directory.

sources.description: Mapping of source filenames to their extraction rules. Each key must be a file name inside the simulators/ directory.

additionalProperties.description: List of field extraction rules for this source file.

from.description: JSONPath expression pointing to the field inside the source JSON.

to.description: Top-level key name in the merged JSON where the extracted value will be placed.

runs.description: Deterministic list of conditional execution rules evaluated in order.

requires_all.description: All listed files must exist for this run to execute.

items.description: Path to a file that must exist.

requires_none.description: None of the listed files may exist for this run to execute.

items.description: Path to a file that must NOT exist.

input_file.description: Path to the merger‑splitter input JSON file to execute when conditions are satisfied.

output_assembler_file.description: Path where the final assembled output object for this run must be written.

success.description: Indicates whether the module completed without errors.

errors.description: List of errors encountered during execution. Empty if execution succeeded.
